name: Francisco Assis - Après le § 1 - Am 14
title: REPORT on the financial activities of the European Investment Bank – annual report 2024
part_text: 5. Emphasises the important role of the EIB Group as a pan-European investment body in mobilising both public and private financing for EU priorities; underlines that EIB support should be focused on projects with a clear economic rationale and EU added value, particularly in the light of a challenging economic outlook and increased global competition; recalls that the EIB must contribute to attracting private investment in Europe;
